name: horsedraft
description: A free horse-race name randomizer for macOS (and any browser). Type up to 20 names, press start, and let the horses decide.
author: op

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && cross-env HORSEDRAFT_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.e2e:app: npm run build && npm run electron:build && playwright test -c playwright.electron.config.ts
